d: Chayan Rastogi and Prashant Kapoor will discuss in this video... the rain-affected third ODI between India and New Zealand, which has left cricket fans wondering what happens next in the series! With rain playing spoilsport and the match washed out, the big question is whether Team India can now secure a series victory. How will the abandoned third ODI affect the series result? What does India need to do in the remaining matches, and can New Zealand still turn things around?
